description_zh: 终端用户调用ListProductsAsEndUser接口查询产品列表
kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog list-products-as-end-user --filters Value=DEMO-Create_ECS Key=ProductName --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order Desc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductsAsEndUser

element_fields.help_en:
The name of the filter condition. Valid values:

- ProductName: performs exact matches by product name. Product names are not case-sensitive.

- FullTextSearch: performs full-text searches by product name, product provider, or product description. Fuzzy match is supported
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的名称。取值：

- ProductName：按产品名称查找，完整匹配（忽略大小写）。
- FullTextSearch：全文检索，按产品名称、产品提供者、产品描述查找，模糊匹配
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The field that is used to sort data.

The default value is CreateTime, which specifies the time when the product was created
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。

取值为CreateTime，表示产品创建时间。
默认取值CreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to sort the returned entries. Valid values:

- Asc: sorts the entries in ascending order.

- Desc (default): sorts the entries in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：

- Asc：正序。
- Desc（默认值）：倒序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size
